title: Build a Mutual Action Plan
objective: Turn 'technical validation next month' into measurable MAP entries.
clearance: Rewritten draft; pending SME and partner clearance

blocks.x: A mutual action plan (MAP) is the joint sequence of commitments, from both the customer and the Glean and partner team, that leads from the next validation to a decision and beyond.

Glean's MAP template lists the evaluation committee (executive sponsor, economic buyer, champion, procurement contact, and implementation contacts), restates the problem and the agreed measures of success, and then sets out dated activities, each with an owner and a purpose. Every MAP entry should capture:

items: **The owner**, on the customer or Glean and partner side.
**The target date**, accepted by the owner.
**Acceptance evidence:** how everyone will know it's done.
The next commercial or delivery milestone, such as security review, order form, or onboarding.

blocks.x: For a demo or Lab validation, use a smaller plan with the same shape.

blocks.label: Boundary
blocks.x: A seller's private close plan isn't automatically mutual. The champion and the relevant decision-makers must confirm their own commitments. Never invent dates on their behalf.
Every MAP entry answers the same six questions. If one is blank, the entry isn't a commitment yet.

blocks.title: Anatomy of a MAP entry
blocks.alt: Six cards naming the fields of a mutual action plan entry: the milestone, the owner, dependencies, the target date, acceptance evidence, and status.

items.label: Acceptance evidence
items.detail: How everyone will know it's done

practice.x: Turn "technical validation next month" into measurable MAP entries.

items: **Confirm scope and readiness.** Owners: the SE and the customer's IT lead. Target: [date]. Evidence: a signed-off scope note.
**Run the agreed validation event.** Owners: the SE and the champion. Target: [date]. Evidence: completed test tasks.
**Review findings against the criteria.** Owners: the joint team. Target: [date].
**Record the sponsor's decision.** Owner: the sponsor. Target: [date].
**Schedule the next gate.** Owner: the AE.

worked.x: Ask each customer owner to accept their dates.
